$comment: Sources: Corebook pp. 82–92 (book='Corebook') and Champions of Order pp. 69–82 (book='Champions of Order'). Cost is 2 XP per Talent (11-advancement/advancement-costs.json). Requirements are informational and DM-checked. Effects are the mechanical text, condensed. downtimeNote marks a part the DM runs. Champions Miracles and Lores (Grungni p. 87, Teclis p. 91, High Peaks p. 103) are not included.

talents.name: A Warm Meal
talents.effect: When you take a Rest, you may spend it cooking a meal for you and your companions. At the end of the Rest, the Binding recovers 1 Soulfire.
talents.downtimeNote: Rest is an in-session action; the Binding gains the Soulfire.

talents.name: Acute Sense
talents.effect: Choose one sense (sight, sound, touch, taste, smell). Dice gained from Training on Awareness Tests with that sense are doubled. The GM may allow Awareness Tests others cannot make.

talents.name: Aether-Khemists Guild Member
talents.requirement: Duardin (Kharadron Overlords), Training (1) and Focus (1) in Crafting
talents.effect: You may take the Aethercraft Endeavour to create aetheric devices (p. 156).

talents.name: Alley Cat
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to hide in a city or to search for someone. You always know which streets to take in a city and can never become lost in one.

talents.name: Ambidextrous
talents.effect: When dual wielding and making an Attack, add 1d6 to your dice pool before splitting the dice for each weapon.

talents.name: Ancestral Memories
talents.effect: When you complete a Rest, gain Training (1) or Focus (1) in one Skill of your choice, or increase your Training or Focus in a Skill you have by 1, to a maximum of 3. This benefit lasts until you finish a Rest, when you may choose a new Skill or keep the same one.

talents.name: Animal Friend
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to get an animal to follow your commands or earn its trust. You know what an animal wants or what might be stressing or harming it.

talents.name: Arcane Discipline
talents.effect: When your spell targets a Zone, you may choose a number of targets equal to your Focus in Channelling to be unaffected by it.

talents.name: Backstab
talents.requirement: Training (1) or Focus (1) in Stealth; a Subtle weapon
talents.effect: If you Attack with a Subtle weapon and the target is unaware of you, the attack deals double Damage and ignores Armour.

talents.name: Barazakdum, the Doom-oath
talents.effect: Whenever your Toughness is at 0, Damage from your attacks is doubled. This is applied before subtracting the target's Armour.

talents.name: Battle Rage
talents.effect: As a Free Action, reduce your Defence a number of steps to increase your Melee by the same number of steps. Battle Rage and the changes to Defence and Melee last until the start of your next turn.

talents.name: Blessed (Choose)
talents.effect: Choose the god who has shown you favour and choose 1 Miracle (see 08-miracles/). Further Miracles cost 2 XP each.

talents.name: Blood Frenzy
talents.effect: On your turn, if you make a melee Attack and deal Damage, your Melee increases one step for your next Attack. It keeps increasing with each subsequent Attack that deals Damage. Melee returns to normal at the end of your turn. No effect against Undead or creatures that do not bleed.

talents.name: Bulwark
talents.effect: If two or more enemies are within Close Range of you at the start of your turn, your Defence increases one step until the start of your next turn.

talents.name: Combat Ready
talents.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to Initiative and can never be Surprised in combat. Each time you take this Talent, the Initiative bonus increases by another +2.

talents.name: Combat Repairs
talents.requirement: Training (1) in Crafting, smith's tools or endrineer's tools
talents.effect: Attempt to repair an ally's Armour in combat. DN depends on rarity and familiarity: DN 4:1 if familiar with the material or the armour is Common; DN 5:1 if unfamiliar or the armour is Rare; DN 6:1 if unfamiliar and the material is unique or magical (e.g. Sigmarite, Sylvaneth natural armour). Each success restores 1 Armour, up to the armour's original rating. Repairs last until the end of combat.

talents.name: Contortionist
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to escape someone's grasp or slip away, such as when grappled. You can fit into unusually small or cramped locations.

talents.name: Criminal
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to steal from someone or to go unnoticed during illicit activities. You can easily find havens of criminal activity such as illegal fight clubs or black market dealers.

talents.name: Crushing Blow
talents.effect: A natural 6 on an Attack with a Crushing weapon against a Large or smaller creature Stuns the target until the end of their next turn.

talents.name: Demolitions Expert
talents.effect: When you use an explosive or weapon with the Blast Trait, you may choose a number of targets equal to your Focus in Crafting to be unaffected by the blast.

talents.name: Diplomat
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to resolve a conflict, gauge people's moods and intentions, and tell if people are lying. Most people act courteously towards you.

talents.name: Eidetic Memory
talents.effect: You recall major elements of a memory with near perfect detail. Minutiae may need a Test; the Skill and DN are set by the GM.

talents.name: Endrineers Guild Member
talents.requirement: Duardin (Kharadron Overlords), Training (1) and Focus (1) in Crafting
talents.effect: You may take the Endrineering Endeavour to forge aetheric devices (p. 156).

talents.name: Fearless
talents.effect: Whenever you would become Frightened due to failing a Test, or are magically influenced to act against your will, you may make a DN 6:1 Mind (Determination) Test to resist.

talents.name: Forbidden Knowledge
talents.effect: Choose a Skill from Arcana, Lore or Theology. When you make a Test with that Skill, the dice gained from your Training are doubled. If you fail the Test, Doom increases by 1 and the GM may introduce future plots caused by it. Each time you take this Talent, choose a new Skill.

talents.name: Graceful Landing
talents.effect: When you fall from a height, you may make a Body (Athletics) Test to avoid Damage. Difficulty is 1 per 10 feet fallen, to a maximum of 6. On success, reduce the Damage by the number of successes.

talents.name: Gunslinger
talents.requirement: Training (1) and Focus (1) in Ballistic Skill
talents.effect: While wielding a ranged weapon in each hand, your Accuracy increases one step.

talents.name: Guts
talents.effect: Gain +1 Toughness for each level of Training in Fortitude.

talents.name: Hail of Doom
talents.requirement: Training (1) or Focus (1) in Ballistic Skill; a ranged weapon
talents.effect: Choose a Zone within your weapon's range and make a DN 4:1 Body (Ballistic Skill) Test. Each enemy in that Zone makes an Opposed DN 4:1 Body (Reflexes) Test. On failure, the target suffers Damage equal to the difference in successes. A target that wins takes no Damage.

talents.name: Hard to Kill
talents.effect: The first Death Test you fail in combat does not increase the DN. The next Test you fail increases the DN as normal.

talents.name: Heavy Hitter
talents.effect: Unarmed strikes deal 1 + S Damage (as printed; 'S' is not defined in this knowledge base, so check the Damage rules before implementing), have the Crushing Trait, and lose the Ineffective Trait.

talents.name: Heroic Challenge
talents.effect: As an Action, choose a creature within Medium Range. If it attacks any target other than you, its Melee and Accuracy decrease one step. If it is a spellcaster, the Complexity of offensive spells that do not target you or your Zone increases by 1. Your Melee increases one step when attacking the target. Lasts until the end of combat.

talents.name: Hit and Run
talents.effect: Once per turn, if you deal Damage with a melee Attack, you may move to an adjacent Zone as a Free Action.

talents.name: Hunter
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to track, find, trap or hunt creatures. Choose one terrain type: Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, Tainted Lands (touched by Chaos or Death), or Tundra. In that terrain you can find a relatively secure place to rest, and cannot be Surprised while resting there.

talents.name: Immense Strikes
talents.effect: Deal +1 Damage with melee weapons that have the Two-handed Trait.

talents.name: Immense Swing
talents.effect: Two-handed melee weapons you wield gain the Cleave Trait.

talents.name: Intimidating Manner
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to threaten, intimidate and start arguments. People often leave you alone even when you are somewhere you do not belong.

talents.name: Iron Stomach
talents.effect: Double the dice gained from Training in Fortitude for Tests to resist poison and disease.

talents.name: Iron Will
talents.effect: Gain +1 Toughness for each level of Training in Determination.

talents.name: Legendary Saga
talents.effect: As an Action, make a Soul (Entertain) Test to chant one saga. Effect lasts until the start of your next turn. Saga of Condemnation (DN 6:1): the Complexity of any spell cast by an enemy with Long Range increases by 1. Saga of Enmity (DN 5:1): any ally that starts its turn in your Zone and can hear you increases Melee and Accuracy one step until the start of its next turn. Saga of Grimnir (DN 6:1): any ally that starts its turn in your Zone and can hear you deals additional Damage on melee Attacks equal to your successes on this Entertain Test.

talents.name: Loyal Companion (Choose)
talents.effect: A familiar or pet that serves as your companion. It gains Toughness equal to your Soul. On your turn you may use an Action to direct it to Move and take an Action. Companions have no Initiative of their own. Companion statistics are in the Bestiary.
talents.downtimeNote: Train Companion Endeavour replaces a dead companion; DM-run.
talents.notes: Champions p. 75 adds Rakerdart and Scryhawk to the companion options.

talents.name: Martial Memories
talents.effect: At the start of combat, choose one: Memories of War (Melee increases one step for the combat); Memories of Defiance (Defence increases one step for the combat); Memories of Dawn (you act first every round for the combat, even ahead of other abilities that would allow an earlier action).

talents.name: Master of Disguise
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to disguise yourself or appear to be someone else. When you take this Talent, create an alternate persona (name, appearance, acquaintances).
talents.downtimeNote: False Identity Endeavour builds the persona; DM-run.

talents.name: Medic
talents.requirement: Training (1) and Focus (1) in Medicine; suitable tools and supplies
talents.effect: Instead of taking a Rest, you may spend it treating one Wound of one ally (say which Wound). Make a Mind (Medicine) Test: DN 4:2 for a Severe Wound, DN 4:3 for a Deadly Wound. On success, the Wound severity reduces two steps at the end of the Rest (Severe is healed; Deadly becomes Minor). On failure, the Wound does not heal. Either way, the ally does not gain the benefits of the Rest.

talents.name: Mounted Combatant
talents.requirement: Training (1) or Focus (1) in Beast Handling
talents.effect: When mounted, your Melee increases one step.

talents.name: Night Vision
talents.effect: You do not suffer Disadvantage on sight Tests in low light or darkness.

talents.name: Observant
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to spot hidden enemies. Natural Awareness increases by 1. You do not suffer a Defence penalty when attacked by a hidden creature.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.effect: Once per round, you may immediately make an Attack when an opponent attempts to move away from you.

talents.name: Orientation
talents.effect: You always know which way is coreward (towards the centre of the realm) and which is edgeward. You can never become lost, except through powerful magic or divine intervention.

talents.name: Patient Strike
talents.effect: Delay your turn to act last in Initiative; your Melee and Accuracy increase one step. When your turn comes, you may Move, take Actions and spend Mettle as normal. At the start of the next round you return to your original place in Initiative.

talents.name: Pierce Armour
talents.requirement: Training (1) in Awareness; a Piercing weapon
talents.effect: Ignore 1 point of Armour for every 6 rolled on an Attack with a Piercing weapon.

talents.name: Point Blank Range
talents.requirement: Training (1) and Focus (1) in Ballistic Skill
talents.effect: No penalty to Accuracy when using a ranged weapon at Close Range.

talents.name: Potent Spells
talents.effect: When a creature must make a Test to resist one of your spells, the number of successes required increases by 1.

talents.name: Quick Reload
talents.effect: Ignore the Reload Trait on any weapon you use.

talents.name: Relentless Assault
talents.requirement: Training (1) and Focus (1) in Weapon Skill
talents.effect: While wielding a melee weapon in each hand, your Melee increases one step.

talents.name: Rending Blow
talents.requirement: Body (3); Focus (1) in Might; a melee weapon
talents.effect: When you make a melee Attack, you may sunder the target's Armour instead of dealing Damage. Armour is reduced by your successes on the Attack, to a maximum of 1 plus your Focus in Might. The Armour is permanently damaged and must be repaired.

talents.name: Savvy
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests when bargaining with merchants or brokering contracts. If you fail a bribe, the target is less likely to take it badly or report you.

talents.name: Scholar
talents.effect: Choose the focus of your study (e.g. history, biology, the realms). Double the dice gained from Training in Lore for Tests on the chosen subject.

talents.name: Sense Ur-Gold
talents.effect: Make a DN 4:1 Soul (Awareness) Test to detect ur-gold nearby. Failure, or no ur-gold within 1,000 feet, means you sense nothing. Success within 1,000 feet gives the general direction. Within Medium Range you know its location to within a few feet. Within Short Range you know its exact location.

talents.name: Sever
talents.requirement: Training (1) in Medicine; a Slashing weapon
talents.effect: A natural 6 on an Attack with a Slashing weapon knocks the target Prone. For the rest of the combat, any time it Moves it suffers 1 Damage that ignores Armour.

talents.name: Shield Mastery
talents.requirement: Training (1) and Focus (1) in Weapon Skill; Training (3) and Focus (3) in Reflexes
talents.effect: When wielding a shield, your Defence increases by one additional step.

talents.name: Sigmar's Judgement
talents.effect: Your Melee and Accuracy increase one step when the target of your Attack is a Daemon or servant of Chaos.

talents.name: Silver Tongue
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to persuade, deceive or seduce others. People remember you fondly and greet you warmly when you return.

talents.name: Sleight of Hand
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to distract, misdirect, steal or hide small objects. Even if thoroughly searched and disarmed, you can hide a palm-sized object on your person.

talents.name: Spellcasting (Choose)
talents.effect: When you gain this Talent, choose one of the Lores of Magic. You learn the spells Arcane Bolt and Mystic Shield, and can choose 4 more spells from the Common Spell list and your Lore's spell list. For more information on Spellcasting, see Chapter 11: Magic. For information on learning new spells, see page 158.
talents.choice: lore: Amber, Amethyst, Bright, Celestial, Gold, Grey, Jade, Light, The Deeps, High Peaks

talents.name: Star-fated Arrow
talents.effect: As an Action, choose a creature you can see within Long Range. The next ranged Attack you make against it ignores Armour.

talents.name: Strong Soul
talents.effect: To calculate Mettle, add your Soul and your level of Training in Devotion, and divide the result by two.

talents.name: Tactician
talents.effect: As an Action, choose an ally within Medium Range. The ally may make an Attack against a creature of your choice if able and has a suitable weapon prepared. If it attacks, it adds bonus dice equal to your Mind. A creature can benefit from this Talent once per round.

talents.name: The Bigger They Are
talents.effect: Your Melee is considered one step higher when fighting beasts or creatures of Large size or greater.

talents.name: Trader's Cache
talents.effect: Make a DN 4:1 Mind (Survival) Test and note the successes. These are your Trader's Cache. After any Test, you may expend successes from the cache to add an equal number of successes to the result. When bargaining or trading you may spend successes to say you have the item the other party wants (GM may require 2 for a Rare item, 3 or more for an Exotic item). The maximum is your Mind plus Training in Survival.
talents.downtimeNote: Replenish the cache by Resting in a city or between adventures; the between-adventures part is DM-run.

talents.name: Unbind
talents.effect: When a creature you can see within Long Range casts a spell, spend 1 Mettle to attempt to unbind it. Make a Mind (Channelling) Test. The Difficulty is the spell's Difficulty, and the Complexity is the total successes the caster achieved. On success the spell has no effect. On failure the spell takes effect as normal.

talents.name: Unbreakable Spells
talents.effect: If a creature attempts to unbind or disrupt your spells, the Complexity of its Test increases by 1 per level of Focus you have in Channelling.

talents.name: Underdog
talents.effect: If two or more enemies and no allies are within Close Range of you at the start of your turn, your Melee increases one step until the start of your next turn.

talents.name: Vanish
talents.effect: You can attempt to hide even when there is no cover or shadows.

talents.name: Weapon Weave
talents.effect: When you take a Rest, make a Soul (Crafting) Test to create a facsimile weapon from roots, vines and fauna. DN 4:1 for any Common Subtle melee weapon or a holy symbol of Alarielle; DN 5:1 for any Common one-handed weapon or a Shield; DN 6:1 for any Common two-handed weapon or a Bow.
talents.downtimeNote: Magical Weapon Weave Endeavour adds magical energy; DM-run.

talents.name: Witch-Sight
talents.effect: You can see the magical energy that permeates the realms. At the GM's discretion you can track and follow the flow of magic.

talents.name: Zharrgrim
talents.effect: You can take the Forge Ur-Gold Rune Endeavour (p. 157).

talents.name: Aether-Efficiency
talents.requirement: Duardin (Kharadron Overlords); Training (2) and Focus (2) in Crafting; an Aether-rig
talents.effect: The overall Power Capacity of your Aether-rig increases by 1.

talents.name: Aetheric Agitator
talents.requirement: Kharadron Overlord; Training (2) or Focus (2) in Crafting
talents.effect: When using equipment with the Aetheric Trait, you may double the listed value of any Blast Trait. However, if you suffer a Serious or Deadly Wound, roll 1d6. On a result of 1, one of the unstable explosives is damaged and detonates on your person, dealing 4 Damage to all creatures in your Zone.

talents.name: Aethermatics Over Superstition
talents.requirement: Duardin (Kharadron Overlords); cannot have Training or Focus in Devotion or Channelling
talents.effect: If you fail an Opposed Test against a Miracle or spell, you can spend a Mettle to reroll the Test. You may reroll a Test only once, and you must take the result of the reroll.

talents.name: Aerial Evasion
talents.requirement: Fly Speed; Training (1) and Focus (1) in Reflexes
talents.effect: While you are Flying, your Defence increases one step against all attacks made from outside your Zone.

talents.name: Affinity with Intricacies
talents.effect: When you make a Test to interact with the delicate internals of intricate machinery, double the bonus gained from any Focus in the Skill being tested.

talents.name: A Good Plan
talents.effect: During a Rest, spend at least an hour planning with your allies. Each participant, including you, makes a DN 4:1 Mind Test, and the successes go into one pool of points. When a party member makes a Test during the planned encounter, they may spend one point to reroll a die or increase its result by 1 before the result is determined. They cannot use more than one die per Test. If the planned encounter does not occur within the next day, the pool is lost.

talents.name: Ancestral Grudge
talents.effect: When making an Opposed Test for the first time against a creature you recognise, roll 1d6. On a 6, you recall that this creature or one of its kind wronged you or your ancestors. You have Advantage on Opposed Tests against that creature until you deem the grudge settled.

talents.name: Applied Anatomy
talents.effect: When you successfully hit a living creature with an attack, add 1 Damage for each 6 rolled on the Attack. This extra Damage cannot exceed your higher level of Training or Focus in Medicine.

talents.name: Arcane Denial
talents.effect: If a spell targets you or your Zone and you are aware of it, add your level of Focus in Arcana to any Tests to resist its effects.

talents.name: Armour Expert
talents.effect: You ignore the Penetrating Trait for attacks made against you. Damage to your armour dealt by the Rend Trait is reduced by 1.

talents.name: Attuned to Nature
talents.requirement: Sylvaneth; Soul (3); Training (1) and Focus (1) in Nature
talents.effect: When you take a Rest in direct contact with the ground or a body of water, clear 2 spaces on your Wound Track instead of 1. If you seek this relief from Chaos-tainted land, make a DN 4:X Soul (Fortitude) Test, where X is the current Doom. On failure, you receive no benefit from the Rest and suffer a Minor Wound.

talents.name: Backup Plan
talents.effect: If you fail a Test and one of the dice rolled was a 1, you may reroll the Test, but its Complexity increases by 1. You cannot reroll a Test more than once this way, and you must Take a Breather or complete a Rest before using this Talent again.

talents.name: Blood of Martyrs
talents.requirement: Blessed (Sigmar); Training (2) and Focus (2) in Devotion
talents.effect: When a Daemon within Close Range damages you with an attack, it suffers 2 Damage for each level of Training you have in Devotion.

talents.name: Blood Sacrifice
talents.effect: When a sapient creature in your Zone dies a violent death, you may spend a Mettle to cast a spell or use a Miracle (paying any Mettle cost of the Miracle as well). If you do, add dice equal to the number of creatures that have died this round to any Channelling or Devotion Tests made as part of this Talent. A Swarm counts as one creature. If non-combatants witness this, the GM may increase Doom by 1. Using unwilling non-combatants' blood, or allowing bystanders to die for it, increases Doom by 1.

talents.name: Born from Agony
talents.requirement: Aelf (Idoneth Deepkin); Training (1) or Focus (1) in Determination; Training (1) or Focus (1) in Fortitude
talents.effect: When you make a Test to resist fear or pain using Determination or Fortitude, you may double your Training and Focus in the Skill being tested.

talents.name: Careful Casting
talents.effect: Roll one less die on the Price of Failure table (Soulbound p. 266), to a minimum of 1d6.

talents.name: Caregiver
talents.effect: When you make a Test to restore Toughness or remove Wounds or Conditions from a creature other than yourself, double the dice gained from your Training in that Skill. This includes magical effects such as spells and Miracles.

talents.name: Collected
talents.effect: Whenever you would become Stunned due to failing a Test, or are magically stricken with confusion, you may immediately make a DN 6:1 Mind (Determination) Test to resist the effect.

talents.name: Combat Sense
talents.effect: You suffer no penalty to Melee, Accuracy or Defence when Blinded or attacked by a hidden creature.

talents.name: Compelling Music
talents.requirement: Soul (3); Training (1) and Focus (1) in Entertain
talents.effect: If you spend at least a minute performing a song, choose one option and make a DN 6:1 Soul (Entertain) Test. On success it affects creatures that willingly listen. A Captivating Song: listeners are Charmed for 10 minutes per success. A Song of Remembrance: each listener gains Advantage on one Opposed Test within the next number of hours equal to your successes. A Triumphant Song: if performed for your Binding during a Rest, the Binding regains 1 Soulfire. Usable once per Rest. The Binding cannot benefit from this and from A Warm Meal in the same Rest.

talents.name: Concussive Shield
talents.effect: If an enemy deals Damage to a creature affected by your Mystic Shield (including yourself), make a DN 4:1 Mind (Channelling) Test opposed by the attacker's Body (Might or Reflexes). If the attacker fails, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

talents.name: Conditioned to Fight
talents.effect: When determining Initiative, you may use Body instead of Mind.

talents.name: Close-Quarters Specialist
talents.requirement: Training (1) and Focus (2) in Weapon Skill
talents.effect: When making an unarmed attack, or attacking at Close Range with a Subtle melee weapon, your Melee increases one step.

talents.name: Counterattack
talents.requirement: Focus (2) in Reflexes and Weapon Skill
talents.effect: Once per turn, when an enemy hits you with a melee Attack, you may use a Free Action to Attack that enemy if it is within range.

talents.name: Crack Shot
talents.requirement: Training (2) and Focus (2) in Ballistic Skill
talents.effect: You deal +1 Damage when you take the Called Shot Action.

talents.name: Creator
talents.effect: The Complexity of Tests to build new items (not repairing or modifying) is reduced by 1.

talents.name: Decisive Action
talents.effect: When you attack a target lower in the Initiative order than you, your Melee and Accuracy increase one step.

talents.name: Devastating Bolts
talents.requirement: Spellcasting (any); Training (2) or Focus (2) in Channelling
talents.effect: When you cast Arcane Bolt, each 6 rolled on your Channelling Test grants +1 Damage, up to your highest level of Training or Focus in Channelling.

talents.name: Dig Deep
talents.requirement: Soul (3); Training (1) and Focus (1) in Determination
talents.effect: When both your Mettle and Toughness are at 0, use a Free Action to regain 1 Mettle. Usable once per round.

talents.name: Dirty Fighting
talents.requirement: Training (1) in Guile; Training (1) in Weapon Skill
talents.effect: When you hit an enemy with an unarmed attack, you may choose to deal no Damage. If you do, the target makes a DN 4:S Body (Fortitude) Test, where S is your successes. On failure it is Blinded or Stunned (your choice) until the start of your next turn.

talents.name: Dispel
talents.requirement: Unbind; Training (2) and Focus (2) in Channelling
talents.effect: As an Action, attempt to dispel a spell that has already taken effect with a Mind (Channelling) Test. The DN is the spell's DN, but the Complexity is one higher. On success the spell is unbound and dispelled. On failure it remains in effect. Each further attempt on the same spell increases the Complexity by one more.

talents.name: Display of Valour
talents.effect: When you kill a non-Minion enemy, allies within Medium Range who witness it lose the Frightened Condition and regain 1 Mettle. Once per combat.

talents.name: Duelist
talents.requirement: Training (2) and Focus (2) in Weapon Skill
talents.effect: If only one enemy and no allies are within Close Range of you, your Melee and Defence increase one step against that enemy until the start of your next turn.

talents.name: Effortless Deceit
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to deceive others, such as lying, forging documents or disguising yourself. You are unaffected by spells and effects that compel you to tell the truth.

talents.name: Emotional Transference
talents.effect: When casting a spell or using a Miracle, you may suffer a Minor Wound. If you do, add 1d6 per Doom to your dice pool for that spell or Miracle.

talents.name: Empathic
talents.effect: When interacting socially with an intelligent creature, and gauging its feelings would help a Test, add 1d6 per level of Training in Intuition. When making an Intuition Test to identify someone's mood, double the benefit of your Training in Intuition.

talents.name: Evasive
talents.effect: After using your Move to leave your Zone and enter another, your Defence increases one step until the start of your next turn. It increases two steps instead when you take the Dodge Action.

talents.name: Executioner
talents.effect: When you hit an Incapacitated, Prone or Restrained creature with an Attack, deal 1 additional Damage for each 6 rolled.

talents.name: Expert Coordinator
talents.effect: All members of your party add 1 to their Initiative while they can see or hear you.

talents.name: Exploding Bolts
talents.requirement: Spellcasting (any); Training (2) or Focus (2) in Channelling
talents.effect: When you cast Arcane Bolt, any creature within Close Range of the target takes half Damage. A creature with a higher Defence than the target may make a DN 4:1 Body (Reflexes) Test opposed by your Channelling roll to avoid the Damage.

talents.name: Fanatical Faith
talents.effect: When you suffer a Wound, make a DN 6:1 Soul (Devotion) Test. On success, the Wound's severity is reduced one step, to a minimum of Minor.

talents.name: Focus on Faith
talents.effect: When you make a Soul (Determination or Fortitude) Test, you may add the benefit of your Focus in Devotion.

talents.name: Gargant's Grip
talents.effect: You can wield equipment with the Two-handed Trait in one hand.

talents.name: Helpful
talents.effect: When you take the Help Action, the recipient adds one additional die to their pool.

talents.name: Hurler
talents.requirement: Body (2); Training (1) or Focus (1) in Athletics
talents.effect: When you throw an item or weapon, its Range increases one step.

talents.name: Industrious
talents.effect: During a period of downtime when you undertake one or more Endeavours, you may take one additional Endeavour.

talents.name: Insightful Interrogator
talents.effect: When making an Intimidation Test to coerce an intelligent creature, use Mind instead of Body or Soul, and you may add your Training and Focus in Intuition to the Test.

talents.name: In the Right Hands
talents.effect: A tool or object solid enough to survive combat (such as a barstool, Endrineer's Tools, Smith's Tools or certain Surgical Instruments) loses the Ineffective Trait when you use it as an Improvised Weapon.

talents.name: Introspective
talents.effect: Whenever you would become Charmed due to failing a Test or a magical effect, you may immediately make a DN 6:1 Mind (Determination or Intuition) Test to resist the effect.

talents.name: Iron Grip
talents.effect: Double the bonus gained from Training in Might on Tests involving the strength of your grip (Grapple, keeping an item from an enemy, holding a ledge). You can ignore effects that would make you drop items you are holding.

talents.name: Iron Lung
talents.effect: You can hold your breath and survive a lack of air for twice as long.

talents.name: Lead from the Front
talents.effect: While you are within Close Range of an enemy that has damaged you since your last turn, allies in your Zone increase their Melee and Accuracy one step.

talents.name: Lead the Way
talents.effect: During your turn, allies that can see you may spend a Mettle to move up to one Zone closer to you. Each ally may do so once per round.

talents.name: Lightning-fast Strikes
talents.effect: When you take the Charge Action, you may attack twice instead of once, making the second attack as a Free Action. You gain the benefit of Charge on both attacks, but your Melee decreases one step for each attack.

talents.name: Lunge
talents.effect: As long as you are not Restrained or Prone, melee weapons you wield gain the Reach Trait if they do not already have it.

talents.name: Lurelight
talents.effect: A lurelight holds a single strong soul or five weak souls. When a creature dies in your Zone, its soul is drawn to the lurelight. Strong soul (from a Champion or Chosen enemy): as an Action, restore 1 Soulfire, or allow a member of the Binding within Long Range to recover one Wound space. Weak soul (from a Minion, Warrior or Swarm creature): as an Action, allow a member of the Binding within Long Range to recover Toughness equal to the souls spent.

talents.name: Meditative Channelling
talents.effect: At the start of your turn, as a Free Action, enter a meditative state: double your Training in Channelling, but you gain the Blinded Condition and cannot Move or Charge that turn. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

talents.name: Mimic
talents.effect: After listening to an intelligent creature speak for at least a minute, you can unerringly mimic its voice and speech patterns.

talents.name: Mollifier
talents.effect: When you take the Parley Action or try to resolve any violent conflict, you have Advantage on Opposed Tests to resolve it.

talents.name: Mountain Stance
talents.effect: As an Action, adopt the mountain stance. You cannot be knocked Prone or moved unless you allow it, and you have Advantage on Tests to knock creatures Prone. If you take the Shove Action in this stance, the target is shoved to an adjacent Zone. End the stance as a Free Action at any time.

talents.name: Natural Weapons
talents.effect: Your hands are natural weapons that deal 1 + S Damage and have the Slashing and Rend Traits. You cannot be disarmed, but they can be broken. Broken natural weapons regrow and are repaired after a Rest, like your natural Armour.
talents.notes: 'S' as printed; not defined in this knowledge base.

talents.name: Nav-League Member
talents.requirement: Duardin (Kharadron Overlords); Training (1) and Focus (1) in Survival
talents.effect: You double your Training in Survival when directing a ship in flight or finding the safest route. When using Aetheric Lenses (Soulbound p. 113), you gain Aethersight: spend a Mettle to attempt to unbind a spell cast by a creature in your Zone, using Mind (Survival) (see Unbind, Soulbound p. 91).

talents.name: Obvious Threat
talents.effect: While you are within Close Range of an enemy, its Defence decreases one step against all Attacks other than yours.

talents.name: Old Enemy
talents.requirement: Mortally Wounded or killed by a creature of the chosen type
talents.effect: Choose a creature type: Automaton, Beast, Daemon, Mortal, Spirit or Undead. Your Melee and Accuracy increase one step when attacking creatures of that type. Repeatable: choose a new type each time.
talents.choice: creature type: Automaton, Beast, Daemon, Mortal, Spirit, Undead

talents.name: Pain Is Power
talents.effect: Once per turn when you suffer a Wound, use a Free Action to immediately cast a single spell. Gain bonus dice to the Channelling Test by Wound severity: +1d6 Minor, +2d6 Serious, +3d6 Deadly.

talents.name: Practised Poisoner
talents.effect: Once per turn, apply poison to a weapon or hide it in food or drink as a Free Action. Advantage on Opposed Tests to conceal this. You cannot accidentally poison yourself while handling poison.

talents.name: Prepared
talents.effect: Add 1d6 to Tests you make during your first turn in combat.

talents.name: Pressing Attack
talents.effect: If you get a 6 on a melee Attack, after determining Damage you may use a Free Action to attempt to Shove the target. If you succeed, you may knock it Prone instead of pushing it away.

talents.name: Prophetic Dreams
talents.effect: At the end of a Rest, roll 2d6 on the Prophetic Dreams table. 2: your nightmares foretell the end of the Mortal Realms; you fear it may come to pass. You do not receive the benefits of the Rest, and Doom increases by 1. 3: one truth, clue or relevant information about a current Long-term Goal of another party member. 4–5: the same, for a current Short-term Goal of another party member. 6–9: no dreams or visions. 10–11: the same, for one of your current Short-term Goals. 12: the same, for one of your current Long-term Goals. The GM is encouraged to provide the information as descriptive scenes.
talents.table: 2d6: 2 Doom+1 no Rest benefit; 3 party Long-term Goal; 4–5 party Short-term Goal; 6–9 nothing; 10–11 own Short-term Goal; 12 own Long-term Goal

talents.name: Read Lips
talents.effect: You can understand speech by watching a creature speak.

talents.name: Ricochet
talents.requirement: Training (2) and Focus (2) in Ballistic Skill
talents.effect: When you make a ranged Attack, the weapon gains the Spread Trait (Soulbound p. 106). Alternatively, when you attack with a weapon that has the Thrown Trait, you may have it ricochet and return to your hand after the attack.

talents.name: Ruthless
talents.effect: When you win an Opposed Test against a creature, add 1 success for each level of Training you have in Determination.

talents.name: Safe House
talents.effect: A private, reliably safe place (worked out with the GM) to lay low and recuperate. It is unknown to outsiders and protects occupants against conventional threats and the elements. Magical detection is not usually foiled. Repeatable: a new safe house each time. If one is compromised, the GM may give a replacement.
talents.downtimeNote: Location is set with the GM.

talents.name: Sceptic's Armour
talents.effect: If a Miracle targets you or your Zone and you are aware of it, add your Focus in Theology to Tests to resist its effects.

talents.name: Scourge
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Intuition and Awareness Tests to recognise Chaos corruption in creatures trying to conceal it. When your Binding undertakes the Cleanse Corruption Endeavour, one ally may take a different Endeavour instead.

talents.name: Shadow Leap
talents.effect: If you are standing fully in shadow, use your Move to instantly reappear at any location within Long Range that is also in shadow and large enough to conceal you. Then make a Body (Stealth) Test as a Free Action.

talents.name: Shining Company
talents.effect: When you start your turn within Close Range of an ally, use a Free Action to fight in formation and choose Melee, Accuracy or Defence. Until the start of your next turn you both increase the chosen ability one step. Lost if either of you moves outside Close Range of the other.

talents.name: Siege Specialist
talents.effect: You deal double Damage when targeting static structures, such as doors, walls or barricades.

talents.name: Soul-Scarred
talents.effect: The injury can never be healed, even by magic or Reforging. You have one less space on your Wound Track. Your maximum Mettle increases by 1.

talents.name: Speed Reading
talents.effect: You read most books in about an hour. Your ability to recall their contents is unchanged.

talents.name: Spellcasting (High Peaks)
talents.requirement: Aelf (Lumineth Realm-lords), Training (1) and Focus (1) in Channelling
talents.effect: When you take this Talent, you learn the spells Arcane Bolt and Mystic Shield, and can choose 4 more spells from the Common Spell list and the Lore of the High Peaks. For more information on Spellcasting, see Soulbound, page 266.

talents.name: Spell Weave
talents.requirement: Spellcasting (any); Training (3) or Focus (3) in Channelling
talents.effect: As an Action, select two different spells you know and make a Channelling Test. Difficulty is the higher of the two spells' Difficulties, and Complexity is the combined Complexity of both (e.g. DN 4:2 and 5:1 give DN 5:3). On success both spells are cast, with additional successes applied to each spell's Overcast, and each may have different targets. On failure you suffer a Serious Wound, and when rolling on the Price of Failure table, roll twice and apply the higher result.

talents.name: Stalwart Guardian
talents.effect: When you take the Defend Action to protect an ally, your Defence increases one step. You have Advantage on Body (Might) Tests using Defend to stop a creature entering your Zone.

talents.name: Stand and Fire
talents.effect: Once per round, when an enemy moves into your Zone, use a Free Action to make a ranged Attack against it.

talents.name: Stay on Your Toes
talents.effect: Your Defence increases one step against Attacks made by enemies lower in the Initiative order than you.

talents.name: Stirring Voice
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests to elicit emotional responses from listeners through your voice (singing, intimidating, garnering pity). People pay attention when you speak and easily recognise your voice.

talents.name: Studied Defence
talents.effect: Spend an Action to study an enemy you can see within Long Range. Until your next Rest, your Defence increases one step against that target's attacks. Only one target at a time.

talents.name: Sure-Footed
talents.effect: Ignore the effects of ground-based Difficult Terrain when moving. When an effect would force you Prone, roll 1d6; on a 6 you keep your feet. If Prone, stand up as a Free Action on your turn.

talents.name: Swagger
talents.effect: Advantage on Opposed Tests where outward confidence matters (convincing someone you're right for a job, bluffing, taking credit). Most people accept your outrageous claims and seldom call your bluffs.

talents.name: Take Aim
talents.effect: As an Action, aim at a target you can see. Until the end of your next turn, your Accuracy against it increases by a number of steps equal to your Focus in Dexterity. Ends early if you take an Action other than attacking the target.

talents.name: Tempt Fate
talents.effect: When you complete a Rest, roll 2d6 and the GM rolls 1d6. If your sum is less than or equal to the GM's roll, Doom increases by 1. If your sum is greater, you gain 2 Fate points. Before a Test, spend a Fate point to replace one die in your pool with a 6. You can never hold more than 2 unspent Fate points.
talents.notes: Fate points are not defined in the Corebook; track them as a counter on the sheet.

talents.name: Territorial
talents.effect: Once per round, as a Free Action, make a melee Attack against an enemy that moves into Close Range of you. With a Reach weapon, you may do so when an enemy enters your Zone.

talents.name: Test of Wrath
talents.effect: You can have a number of active ur-gold runes greater than your Soul. For each rune beyond your Soul, you have one less space on your Wound Track. This does not count as a Wound and cannot be healed. When active runes are equal to or less than your Soul, the Wound Track returns to normal. See Soulbound p. 117 for ur-gold runes.

talents.name: Thoughtful
talents.effect: When you make a Mind Test and can afford to mull things over, double the dice gained from Training in the Skill being Tested. Not for reflexive actions, conversation, combat or spellcasting.

talents.name: Tinkerer
talents.effect: The Complexity of Tests to modify or repair existing items (not creating new ones) is reduced by 1.

talents.name: Tireless
talents.effect: When an Endeavour requires an Extended Test, you can make 1 additional Test.

talents.name: Trap Savvy
talents.effect: When you build, modify, set or disarm a trap, double the bonus gained from any Focus in the Skill being tested.

talents.name: Trophy Taker
talents.effect: When you defeat a Champion or Chosen type enemy, you may claim an unmistakable trophy from its body. Once per combat, as a Free Action, recover 1 Mettle or recover from the Frightened Condition by displaying a trophy. Each trophy works once.

talents.name: Unbowed
talents.effect: Whenever you would become Prone due to failing a Test or a magical effect, you may immediately make a DN 6:1 Body (Determination) Test to resist.

talents.name: Unbridled Malice
talents.effect: The first time you make a melee attack against a creature, it makes a DN 4:X Soul (Determination) Test, where X is the Damage it suffered. On failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

talents.name: Unnerving Grace
talents.effect: When you make a Body (Intimidation) Test, you may use Stealth in place of Intimidation and gain Advantage on the Test.

talents.name: Unstoppable Force
talents.effect: When you Charge, ignore Difficult Terrain and add 1d6 to your dice pool for the attack.

talents.name: Ur-gold Mastery
talents.requirement: Zharrgrim; Focus (2) in Devotion and Theology
talents.effect: As an Action, reactivate an inert ur-gold rune (yours or another Fyreslayer's). It does not count towards the target's total runes. Lasts until your next period of downtime. Only one inert rune per creature can be reactivated this way, and a creature cannot have multiple inert runes reactivated at once. Another Zharrgrim targeting the same creature has no effect.

talents.name: Vexation
talents.effect: When a creature that can see or hear you within Medium Range makes a Test, spend a Mettle to remove dice from its pool equal to your Training in Guile.

talents.name: Virtuoso
talents.effect: Choose one kind of performance (storytelling, jokes, singing, acting, writing or oration). When you make an Entertain Test for that kind, double the bonus gained from your Focus in Entertain.

talents.name: Warded
talents.effect: Take 1 less Damage when a spell damages you.

talents.name: Weight of Destiny
talents.effect: Your Binding's maximum Soulfire increases by 1. Once per adventure you can recover a Soulfire at any time. Each period of downtime without progress toward your destiny increases Doom by 1; if you actively avoided it, Doom increases by 2.

talents.name: Well-Connected
talents.effect: When you undertake the Contacts Endeavour, you may make or strengthen one additional contact.

talents.name: Witch's Hammer
talents.requirement: Training (3) in Arcana; Focus (3) in Weapon Skill; a melee weapon
talents.effect: When a creature in your Zone casts a spell, spend a Mettle to attempt to unbind it using Body (Weapon Skill) (see Unbind, Soulbound p. 91).

talents.name: Word on the Street
talents.effect: When you make a Lore Test to learn about local news and rumours, double the bonus gained from your Focus in Lore.

talents.name: Zealotry
talents.effect: When you make an Intimidation Test, you may add your Training in Devotion to your dice pool.

lores.name: Amber
lores.effect: Lore of Ghur: the hunter and the hunted, the beast and its prey.

lores.name: Amethyst
lores.effect: Lore of Shyish: endings and death.

lores.name: Bright
lores.effect: Lore of Aqshy: flames and burning passions.

lores.name: Celestial
lores.effect: Lore of Azyr: the unknown, prognostication, storms and the stars.

lores.name: Gold
lores.effect: Lore of Chamon: metallurgies and transmutations.

lores.name: Grey
lores.effect: Lore of Ulgu: shadow, mist, illusions and lies.

lores.name: Jade
lores.effect: Lore of Ghyran: growth, healing and the power of nature.

lores.name: Light
lores.effect: Lore of Hysh: illumination, purity and truth; opposes Grey magic.

lores.name: The Deeps
lores.effect: Lore of the Idoneth: abyssal depths and the dark corners of a living being's psyche.
